t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 2 groups that have been categorised, "Orange, Yellow, Green and Blue" and "Others". These are the colours that represent the gnomes that lead you to the forest, keep alternating between these 2 categories. You will notice your points get lower and lower the more you focus on one category.

vb_textbox.text: You should consider the gnomes as working in 2 teams, team 1 consists of the green, blue, orange and yellow gnomes and the other gnomes are part of team 2. You will notice each team will take you to a specific forest with a specific colour basket (Red or Yellow). You will need to keep changing between each team to score as high as possible. You will also notice that the faster you press "space" on the basket the more you might earn. There also feels to be an element of randomness when you receive 0 mushrooms from a basket. Good Luck!
